Mercury contamination of the material will be cause for rejection. If the inclusion of metallic mercury is required as a functional part of the material furnished under this contract, the Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Procurement Contracting Officer before proceeding with manufacture. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. For background, the following information is provided: Mercury is corrosive to gold, silver, nickel, stainless steels, aluminum and copper alloys. Stainless steels, nickel, and copper alloys are widely used in reactor plants and other submarine/surface ship systems. Accidental trapping of mercury in a component could cause serious damage to vital parts. Mercury is also toxic if inhaled, ingested, or absorbed through the skin. It is evident that grave consequences could result from small amounts of mercury vapor present in an unreplenished submarine/surface ship atmosphere. 4. Except as otherwise specified, the contractor may use his own or any other facility suitable for the performance of the inspection requirements specified herein. PROCEDURES:The contractor shall prepare and maintain Quality Control Documentation, test and repair procedures, and inspection procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROGRAM PLAN: The contractor shall develop, implement and maintain a Repair Quality Plan in compliance with the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q-9858, ISO,9000 / 9001 / 9002, or equvalent.The plan shall define the specific methods by which compliance with contractual requirements will be assured. title: Maintenance, Repair and Preservation of YT-811
description: The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS and IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish maintenance, repair, and preservation of YT-811. The YT-811 characteristics are Length: 90 FT, Width: 38FT 5IN, Age: 4 Years, Hull Type: Steel, Draft: 16 FT, Full Displacement: 494 L Tons and Light Load: 438 L Tons.The Contractors facility must possess the capability of YT-811 with the dimensions as stated above. To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the SUPERVISOR to deliver the vessel to the Contractors facility. The Government will transport the vessel to the Contractors repair facility. Upon docking vessel, wash, and clean vessel. Replace zinc anodes. Blast and preserve underwater hull and freeboard, bulwarks, and handrails. Blast and preserve main deck, 1st deck, and 2nd deck non-skid, FME all polished stainless steel surfaces. Perform hull and freeboard Ultrasonic Test (UT) inspections. Perform hull and freeboard, main deck, 1st deck, and 2nd deck Visual Inspections (VT). Repair hull and winch valves. Repair deckhouse expansion joint. Test and preserve CHT, ballast, potable water, fuel oil, waste oil and day tanks. Accomplish Mast Lighting and Deckhouse Lighting Repairs. Replace all placards and labels on main, 1st and 2nd decks. Replace deck winch, mast, and brow systems hydraulic hoses. Accomplish winch control piping modification (YT-0104D). Overhaul Mast hydraulic ram, replace pins and bushings. Undock the vessel. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the SUPERVISOR. Upon completion of all work the Government will take custody of the vessel. Specific details of all work items and tasks required by this Statement of Work described in this Scope Overview are included in section 3.0 of this Statement of Work.The YT-811 will be ready for pick up on or after 2 March 2027. Refer to page 1 Request for Quote (RFQ) of the Solicitation regarding desired and required delivery information.This is full and open competition. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov.

title: Market Intelligence Notice � Hangar Construction (Hybrid Conventional and Tension Fabric Structures)
description: Market Intelligence Notice � Hangar Construction (Hybrid Conventional and Tension Fabric Structures) Disclaimer: This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or a commitment to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI. 1.0 Objective The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Savannah District (SAS) is seeking market intelligence to identify and assess industry capabilities relevant to Tension Fabric Structures (TFS) and hybrid industrialized construction solutions for hangar facilities and similar large-span mission support applications. The Government is pursuing modern industrialized construction approaches intended to improve schedule, cost, and lifecycle outcomes for this facility type. Information provided by respondents will be used to help the Government understand available market participants, solution types, and industry interest, and will inform future industry engagements, acquisition planning, and assessment of potential use of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a, Facility Construction or Repair: Transactions Other Than Contracts and Grants. 2.0 Forecasted Projects - Overview The following projects are currently projected for potential TFS or hybrid industrialized construction applications. USACE, SAS requires a highly resilient, energy-efficient operational hangar facility that can be rapidly constructed, scaled, and reconfigured as a tension-fabric structure. Solutions may be scaled for additional hangar facilities identified later. Maintenance Hangar, Hunter Army Airfield (HAAF), GA (approximately 193,513 square footage (SF)). Construction of a Large (10 Module) Standard Design Aircraft Maintenance Hangar Complex with integrated aviation maintenance operations, maintenance support, company operations, flight planning, flight operations spaces, Ground Support Equipment (GSE) covered storage, Associated Support Items of Equipment (ASIOE) covered storage, Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) and Hazardous Material (HAZMAT) storage, hangar access and wash aprons. Project also includes fire protection and alarm systems, information systems, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) installation, closed circuit television connection, cybersecurity measures, and Energy Monitoring Control Systems (EMCS) connection. Supporting facilities include site development, utilities and connections, exterior lighting, paving, POV parking, walks, storm drainage, information systems, landscaping and signage. Heating and air conditioning will be provided by self-contained system. Moody Air Force Base, GA (approximately 105,000 SF). Construction of an adequately sized six-bay hangar and squadron operations facility. The squadron operations section of the facility shall incorporate mission planning, life support, and squadron admin space. The aircraft maintenance section shall be designed to optimize maintenance administration for the squadron. The hangar bays will provide space to support aircraft repair and inspection, engine changes, and other activities that must be accomplished in a secure, climate-controlled environment. The hangar space must be sized to accommodate movement and placement of maintenance equipment around the aircraft and systems supporting the aircraft. 3.0 Requested Information & Market Intelligence Questionnaire Section - General Information Provide responses to the survey linked herein. https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/8B5GPKqrMh Section - Capabilities Respondents are asked to structure Capability Statements to include the following elements: Corporate Overview - A brief summary of your firm's core capabilities, relevant experience, and capacity to perform the type of work contemplated under this RFI. Commercial Best Practices. To the extent available, provide information regarding commercial best practices applicable to the contemplated construction delivery method, including: Typical pricing/payment structures Geographic coverage Typical project schedule timelines, long lead items, and key decision points Key considerations and risk associated with permitting, logistics, staffing/labor availability, and construction execution. Specialized Systems Integration: Describe your experience integrating specialized hangar systems, such as high-capacity cranes, fall protection systems, and high-expansion foam fire suppression systems, within a tension fabric structure. Supply Chain and Logistics: Describe your supply chain for key components of the tension fabric structure. What are your typical lead times for material and fabrication? Materials and Durability: What specific materials, coatings, and structural frame materials do you typically use for facilities of this type and in a coastal environment? What is the expected design life and warranty period for these components? 3. Survey Responses � Please provide detailed responses to Survey Questions 10 through 12 (listed below and on the survey form). Respondents are asked to integrate these responses directly into their capability statements; separate or stand-alone survey responses are not required. Additional Information � Respondents may include other information that demonstrates their relevant capabilities, experience, and capacity. Examples include: Photos of TFS projects ; Smart Building Technologies (e.g., automated controls, sensors, energy management systems, fire protection and alarm systems, information systems, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) installation, closed circuit television connection, cybersecurity measures, and Energy Monitoring Control Systems (EMCS) connection.) Advanced HVAC Systems (e.g., high-efficiency climate control, specialized filtration) Survey Questions 10-12 10. Describe your experience or capability in designing and constructing tension-fabric structures that could innovate and accelerate construction. 11. Describe your firm�s practical experience with collaborative delivery models, such as Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build or Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR), where your team was integrated into the design phase. What specific pre-construction services did you provide? 12. For the projects listed in response to Q11, identify the major subcontractor(s) used and describe their qualifications. Detail the teaming relationship and contract structure between the construction contractor, the owner, and the Designer of Record. Explain how your team's involvement improved the final design quality, accelerated the delivery schedule, and reduced overall project cost. 4.0 Response Submission Instructions Format: Responses to the survey must be submitted via the link provided. The capability statement must be submitted in PDF format, single-spaced, using 11-point font or larger. Submission Deadline: October 23, 2026 � 5:00 PM Submission Channel: Complete the survey at https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/8B5GPKqrMh Submit capability statement via email to the Agreement Officer (AO) at Jennifer.L.Murphy@usace.army.mil and copy Sabrina.Bastine@usace.army.mil with the subject line: "USACE OTA Market Intelligence Response TFS - [Company Name]". Proprietary Information: Any proprietary, sensitive, or business-confidential information must be clearly marked as such on each page to ensure proper handling by USACE SAS.

title: HPCMP Innovative Technology Insertion of Advanced HPC Systems Commercial Solutions Openings (CSO)
description: The Engineer Research and Development Center (ERDC) is issuing a Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) pursuant to DFARS Subpart 212.70. Under a CSO, the ERDC may competitively award proposals received in response to a general solicitation, similar to a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), to acquire innovative commercial products, technologies, or services based on a review of solutions by scientific, technological, or other subject matter expert peers within the ERDC. �Innovative,� for CSO purposes, means any new technology, process, or method, including research and development (R&D), or any new application of an existing technology, process, or method. Under this CSO, all products, technologies, and services shall be treated as commercial items; products, technologies, and services do not have to be �commercially available� to be submitted in response to this solicitation. If the solution meets the requirements of the regulation, the solution is treated as commercial whereby the Contracting Officer will utilize commercial procedures to develop and execute the resultant award. The DoW High Performance Computing Modernization Program (HPCMP) is seeking innovative solutions to establish a new high-performance computing (HPC) system acquisition and support services model that leverages industry best practices to transform how the HPCMP procures, operates, and maintains its newest HPC systems for 2027. The HPC systems being considered are a combination of compute-intensive architectures and artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) platforms operating in either unclassified or classified (secret and above-secret) environments. The systems would be geographically distributed at up to three of the five HPCMP DoW Supercomputing Resource Centers (DSRCs). Since the systems will reside on-premises in the DSRCs, the services model must also conform to DoW and local Service policies, especially regarding security (physical, personnel, and cyber). To navigate the current market conditions and meet mission objectives, a new strategy is needed to design, manufacture, deliver, install, operate and maintain one or more HPC systems at one to three different HPC centers. The anticipated systems will be a combination of compute-intensive architectures (mostly CPU-based) and artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) platforms (mostly GPU-based) operating in either unclassified or classified (secret and above-secret) environments. Go to https://www.erdcwerx.org/innovative-technology-insertion-of-advanced-hpc-systems/ for all of the CSO details and submission requirements. All solutions must be submitted through the ERDCWERX platform. The ERDC may award a FAR-based contract or an Other Transaction under this announcement. All resultant FAR-based contracts will be firm-fixed price. All items, technologies, and services (including research and development) procured via this CSO are treated as commercial. Applicants from universities and/or non-profit organizations should be aware that commercial clauses will be integrated into the award and should coordinate proposals with associated legal counsel prior to submission.

title: Request for Information: United States Coast Guard Core Navigation Software
description: Description & Purpose of Request 1.1 Objective The United States Coast Guard (USCG) is conducting market research in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 to identify commercially available off-the-shelf (COTS) and Non-Developmental Item (NDI) core maritime navigation software solutions that have the capability of being enhanced to meet USCG requirements (e.g. EAIS IDD). The primary objective is to survey industry capabilities to inform the prospective modernization and eventual replacement of the legacy USCG �Vega� navigation software suite (currently derived from commercial core navigation architectures) across the cutter and boat fleet. 1.2 Purpose & Scope of Market Inquiry The Coast Guard seeks insight into the current commercial and naval navigation software, including cutting-edge display engines, autonomous voyage planning, sensor fusion, resilient Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), and modern software architectures (e.g., modular open systems, containerized microservices, cross-platform runtimes). The Government intends to assess software suites that can match or exceed the complete operational baseline of current USCG E-NAV capabilities while remaining flexible, open, and capable of integrating seamlessly into existing USCG shipboard hardware configurations without requiring complete bridge refits. 1.3 Disclaimer This is a Request for Information (RFI) and is issued solely for informational, market research, and planning purposes. This is not a Request for Proposals or a Request for Quotations, and it is not considered to be a commitment by the Government to award a contract/order nor is the Government responsible for any costs incurred in furnishing information provided under this RFI. No basis for claim against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this RFI or Government use of any information provided. Further, the Government is not seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals at this time. No classified, confidential, or sensitive information should be included in your response to this RFI. Proprietary information must be clearly marked if included. The Government reserves the right to use any information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate, including using technical information provided by respondents in any resultant solicitation. Responses will assist the Government in determining the availability of potential solutions and commercial products in the market. At this time, no solicitation exists; therefore, please do not request a copy of the solicitation. description: The Defense Logistics Agency-Aberdeen, on behalf of the Army Integrated Logistics Supply Center (ILSC) � Supply Chain Management Directorate (SCMD) � Strategic Sourcing Directorate (SSD), intends to acquire Parts to support the Electronic Shop Vans (ESVs). Requirements Description: This is a market survey to locate additional sources of supply for a COMMERCIAL 28VDC Power Supply for use in Electronic Maintenance Repair Vans, throughout the world. It converts the 60Hz, 120/208VAC, 3-phase input power to 28VDC electrical power, available to each of the workstations at the 28VDC electrical posts. PLEASE NOTE: This is NOT a market survey to locate additional sources of supply to design/develop a 28VDC Power Supply, again, it is for a commercially available 28VDC Power Supply. Additional Sources of supply for a 28VDC PWR Supply must offer a commercially available 28VDC PWR Supply that is an equal substitute for form/fit/function. Interchangeability exist in electrical input/output interface cables, to allow easy plug-in with existing cables that are inside the ESVs. Interchangeability shall also exist in fit, so that the replacement 28VDC PWR Supply will fit exactly in the designated compartment of the electrical rack that is inside the ESVs. Each offeror must provide all supporting equipment specifications data/documents for your proposed 28VDC Power Supply and provide any supporting technical documentation to verify/prove that your proposed commercial equipment is equal to P/Ns previously placed in the ESVs, as explained above. The burden of proof is on the offeror to prove that their commercial equipment satisfies the above form/fit/function requirement. title: Maintenance, Repair and Preservation of YT-811
description: The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS and IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish maintenance, repair, and preservation of YT-811. The YT-811 characteristics are Length: 90 FT, Width: 38FT 5IN, Age: 4 Years, Hull Type: Steel, Draft: 16 FT, Full Displacement: 494 L Tons and Light Load: 438 L Tons. The Contractors facility must possess the capability of YT-811 with the dimensions as stated above. To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the SUPERVISOR to deliver the vessel to the Contractors facility. The Government will transport the vessel to the Contractors repair facility. Upon docking vessel, wash, and clean vessel. Replace zinc anodes. Blast and preserve underwater hull and freeboard, bulwarks, and handrails. Blast and preserve main deck, 1st deck, and 2nd deck non-skid, FME all polished stainless steel surfaces. Perform hull and freeboard Ultrasonic Test (UT) inspections. Perform hull and freeboard, main deck, 1st deck, and 2nd deck Visual Inspections (VT). Repair hull and winch valves. Repair deckhouse expansion joint. Test and preserve CHT, ballast, potable water, fuel oil, waste oil and day tanks. Accomplish Mast Lighting and Deckhouse Lighting Repairs. Replace all placards and labels on main, 1st and 2nd decks. Replace deck winch, mast, and brow systems hydraulic hoses. Accomplish winch control piping modification (YT-0104D). Overhaul Mast hydraulic ram, replace pins and bushings. Undock the vessel. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the SUPERVISOR. Upon completion of all work the Government will take custody of the vessel. Specific details of all work items and tasks required by this Statement of Work described in this Scope Overview are included in section 3.0 of this Statement of Work. The YT-811 will be ready for pick up on or after 2 March 2027. Refer to page 1 Request for Quote (RFQ) of the Solicitation regarding desired and required delivery information. This is full and open competition. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov.

title: Denmark – Floodgates – Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel
description: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel Beskrivelse (dansk): Beredskabsstyrelsen ("BRS") ønsker sammen med landets 30 kommunale redningsberedskaber ("de Kommunale Beredskaber") at indgå en rammeaftale om anskaffelse af mobilt dæmningsmateriel i form af fritstående oversvømmelsesbarrierer. Anskaffelsen har primært til formål at understøtte BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers akutte håndtering af klimahændelser, herunder ved varsling om forhøjet vandstand fra bagland såvel som havvand, samt ved indsats i forbindelse med større brande. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal anvendes både selvstændigt i forbindelse med håndteringen af bl.a. klimahændelser, ligesom det skal indgå som supplement til BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers eksisterende opdæmningsmateriel. Materiellet skal kunne anvendes i flere forskellige indsatsscenarier. Det skal for det første kunne etableres hurtigt og fleksibelt over varierende strækninger ved ekstraordinære vandstandsstigninger, herunder ved akut indsats i baglandet, f.eks. ved søer og åer, samt ved kyster og havne. Det skal for det andet kunne benyttes til beskyttelse af enkeltobjekter, f.eks. kritisk infrastruktur. Det skal for det tredje kunne anvendes som vandreservoir i forbindelse med større brandindsatser, hvor vand anbringes i reservoiret, hvorfra én eller flere pumper fordeler vandet til indsatsområdet. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal have en primær højde svarende til højden på BRS' eksisterende og mest anvendte opdæmningsmateriel. Da de lokale beredskabers risikovurderinger og behov varierer, ønskes der herudover tilbudt opdæmningsmateriel i andre højder, som muliggør tilpasning til områder med behov for lavere eller højere opdæmning. Det er væsentligt, at materiellet tillader hurtig, let og effektiv transport, etablering og nedtagning, herunder at håndteringen kan ske med et minimum af ressourcer og på en arbejdsmiljømæssigt forsvarlig måde. Materiellet forudsættes at kunne benyttes flere gange. Materiellet vil blive oplagret på lager og transporteret til indsatsområderne via lastbil. Under indsættelse skal materiellet kunne håndteres ved håndkraft, herunder aflæsses, opsættes, nedtages og læsses, af et minimalt mandskab. Rammeaftalen har en varighed af 4 år fra underskrift.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Objektplanungsleistungen für Gebäude und Innenräume nach Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 HOAI, Vorabmaßnahmen am NWZ I für die Sanierung von NWZ II
description: Universität Stuttgart; NWZ II, Sanierung für Chemie, Objektplanungsleistungen für Gebäude und Innenräume nach Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 HOAI, Vorabmaßnahmen am NWZ I für die Sanierung von NWZ II, Pfaffenwaldring 55, 70569 Stuttgart, Das Naturwissenschaftliche Zentrum (NWZ) I und II im Pfaffenwaldring (PWR) 55 und 57 wurde in den 1970er Jahren fertiggestellt. Das NWZ soll in den kommenden Jahren abschnittsweise generalsaniert werden. Sanierungsabschnitt 1 betrifft das NWZ II, während Sanierungsabschnitt 2 das NWZ I betrifft. Die in diesem Verfahren ausgeschriebenen Planungsaufgaben sind die Vorabmaßnahmen am NWZ I im Vorgriff auf die geplante Sanierung des NWZ II im ersten Sanierungsabschnitt. Sie sind Teil der Gesamtsanierungsmaßnahme NWZ. Es müssen diverse Anpassungsmaßnahmen am NWZ I erfolgen, um die beiden Gebäude seitens des Hochbaus und der Gebäudetechnik zu entflechten und abzutrennen. Zudem müssen bisherige Nutzungen aus dem NWZ II für dessen Sanierung interimsweise im NWZ I untergebracht und dort vorhandene Nutzungen verdichtet werden. Im Laborhochhaus des NWZ I (PWR 55) mit östlich angrenzenden Flachbauten ist die die Fakultät Chemie untergebracht. In den Flachbauten sind Hörsäle, die Universitätsbibliothek und eine Cafeteria verortet. Das NWZ I verfügt über insgesamt 23.800 m² NUF (1-6). Die zur Beauftragung vorgesehenen Objektplanungsleistungen beziehen sich auf Teilflächen des Gebäudes mit ca. 2.900 m² NUF und umfassen im Wesentlichen die Arbeiten an: Bibliothek mit ca. 2.520 m² NUF, Verwaltungs- und Fachschaftsflächen mit ca. 90 m² NUF sowie Praktika- und Laborflächen mit ca. 290 m² NUF. Die Maßnahme beinhaltet zudem Arbeiten an betriebsrelevanten Ver- und Entsorgungsanlagen wie z.B. Anlagen für technische Gase und Abwasserbehandlung. Das Gebäude befindet sich größtenteils im Errichtungszustand mit entsprechenden bauzeitlichen Schadstoffbelastungen. Bei den Maßnahmenhandelt es sich um Interimslösungen bis zur geplanten Inbetriebnahme des NWZ II und der Generalsanierung des NWZ I. Das Gebäude befindet sich in der Campusmitte innerhalb einer dichten/beengten städtebaulichen Struktur. Die Umsetzung erfolgt im regulären Universitäts-/Gebäudebetrieb. Kosten: Die Bauwerkskosten (KG 300-400) betragen ca. 8.000.000 Euro brutto. Nicht berücksichtigt sind hierbei die Kosten für mögliche Baupreis- und Bauherrenrisiken. Termine: Der Projektstart ist Ende Januar mit der Auftragserteilung terminiert. Abschluss der LPH 2 ist im März 2027 geplant und hinsichtlich der Gesamtterminschiene zwingend erforderlich. Fertigstellung der Maßnahme ist im 1. Quartal 2031 vorgesehen. Objektplanungsleistungen für Gebäude und Innenräume nach Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 HOAI nach Teil 3 Abschnitt 1 HOAI, Grundleistungen der Leistungsphasen 2 bis 9 nach § 34 HOAI sowie Besondere Leistungen der Leistungsphase 2.

title: Germany – Guttering work – Metalldach / Regenentwässerung
description: Die Behörde für Justiz und Verbraucherschutz beabsichtigt, eine für den Justizvollzug nicht mehr benötigte Teilfläche des aktuellen Geländes der JVA Fuhlsbüttel freizuziehen. Zu diesem Zwecke ist geplant, die sich auf der Teilfläche befindlichen Nutzungseinheiten der Anstalt durch die Realisierung zweier Neubauten auf die weiterhin genutzte Fläche zu verlagern. Die aktuelle Versorgungsstruktur der JVA Fuhlsbüttel sowie die Wegeführungen auf dem Anstaltsgelände sind aufgrund des Freizugs der Teilfläche anzupassen. Zur Abgrenzung der verbleibenden Anstaltsfläche gegenüber der freizuziehenden Teilfläche ist außerdem die Außensicherung der JVA Fuhlsbüttel in Teilen neu zu planen und zu versetzen. Hierfür sind einige Bestandsbauten der Anstalt vollständig oder in Teilen zurückzubauen Am Standort der JVA Fuhlsbüttel sollen zwei Ersatzneubauten erstellt werden; ein Ausbildungsgebäude (A), dieses zentral auf dem JVA-Gelände, sowie ein Garagen- und Verwaltungsgebäude (B) mit Anbindung an eine Bestandspforte. Die jeweils viergeschossigen Neubauten werden als Mischkonstruktion aus Mauerwerk, Ortbeton und Betonfertigteilelementen, ohne Unterkellerung mit einer Sohle aus WU-Beton erstellt. Die Außenhüllen der Gebäude werden mit Verblendsteinen bekleidet und erhalten ein Satteldach als Pfettendach aus Nadelholz mit Metalldacheindeckung. Sämtliche Fensteröffnungen werden vergittert, Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Metalldacheindeckung und Herstellung der Regenentwässerung. Wesentliche Arbeiten: Für die Neubauten ATV DIN 18339 Klempnerarbeiten

title: Germany – Turntable-ladder trucks – Beschaffung einer DLAK 23/12 für die Freiwillige Feuerwehr der Stadt Landshut
description: Beschafft wird eine Automatik-Drehleiter mit Rettungskorb Typ DLAK 23/12 entsprechend DIN 14043, bestehend jeweils aus Fahrgestell mit Aufbau (geschuldeter Erfolg).Das Fahrzeug muss den nachfolgenden Normen und Richtlinien in ihrer jeweils letztgültigen Fassung entsprechen: DIN EN 1846 Teil 1 - 3, DIN 14555 Teil 22, 14502 Teil 2 und 3 (Restnorm), der EMV Richtlinie für Kraftfahrzeuge, der Richtlinie 2004/104/EG über die Funkentstörung von Kraftfahrzeugen (ergänzt durch 2005/49/49/EG, 2005/83/EG, 2006/28/EG und 2009/19/ EG), EN 50081: 1998, EN 50082: 1998, ETS 300 113 und 300 390 für ETSI-Spezifikation Tetra-Standard, den Aufbaurichtlinien des Fahrgestellherstellers, allen einschlägigen UVV-Richtlinien, den Vorschriften über elektrische Anlagen und Betriebsmittel (VDE-/ DIN-Normen). Das Fahrzeug benötigt zulassungstechnisch alle Systeme und Vorrüstungen gemäß (EU) 2144/2019, eine Zulassung muss auch in Anbetracht rechtlicher Änderungen zum angebotenen Lieferzeitpunkt uneingeschränkt und ohne Sondergenehmigung möglich sein. Es muss geliefert werden einschließlich der Unterbringung der feuerwehrtechnischen Beladung in dem Feuerwehraufbau und aufgesetzt auf Straßenfahrgestellen. Die über die Norm hinaus gehenden unterschiedlichen Beladungen sind bestimmungsgemäß, den Vorgaben dieser Ausschreibung und des Auftraggebers zu lagern. Aufgrund der geplanten Nutzungsdauer von mindestens 20 Jahren wird besonders großer Wert auf eine fachgerechte und solide Verarbeitung gelegt. Auf eine ergonomische Bedienung und Entnahme der Ausrüstung wird allergrößter Wert gelegt.Insbesondere auf die Sicherung der gelagerten Ausrüstung im Bereich des Fahrerhauses mit mindestens 10 g wird ausdrücklich hingewiesen. Die Auftragsdurchführung muss diese Motive berücksichtigen, d.h. insbesondere, dass die Ausrüstungsgegenstände soweit technisch darstellbar nach den Anforderungen des Auftraggebers zu verlasten sind.

title: Germany – Computer equipment and supplies – Rahmenvereinbarung Beschaffung von Hardware für die IFB
description: Die Hamburgische Investitions- und Förderbank (nachstehend IFB genannt) ist eine rechtsfähige Anstalt des Öffentlichen Rechts und unterstützt die Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg bei ihrer wirtschafts- und strukturpolitischen sowie sozialpolitischen Entwicklung. Als Spezialkreditinstitut mit rund 380 Beschäftigten werden moderne Kommunikations- und Netzwerkstrukturen zur Wahrnehmung der gesetzlichen Aufgaben eingesetzt. Die Geschäftsräume der IFB befinden sich im Besenbinderhof 31 und 37 in 20097 Hamburg. __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Die IFB benötigt zur Ausstattung ihrer wachsenden Zahl von Mitarbeitenden regelmäßig verschiedene Hardware und Zubehör, insbesondere Notebooks und Bildschirme. Die IFB beabsichtigt, eine Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem oder mehreren Vertragspartnern für die Beschaffung einheitlicher Hardware abzuschließen. Weitere Dienstleistungen (Ab- und Aufbau der Hardware, Softwareverteilung, Aktualisierung des Betriebssystems sowie im Leistungsschein vorinstalliertes Windows 11 Software-Lizenzierung) sind nicht Teil des Vergabeverfahrens und werden von der IFB selbst übernommen. __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Die Auftragserteilung erfolgt über ein Kaskadenprinzip mit den drei bestplatzierten Unternehmen. Der Zweitplatzierte wird dann beauftragt, wenn der Erstplatzierte nicht in einer gesetzten Frist von vier Wochen liefern kann. Und der Drittplatzierte, wenn der Zweitplatzierte nicht in einer gesetzten Frist von vier Wochen liefern kann. title: Germany – Building construction work – Stadt Bochum: Totalunternehmerleistungen / Totalübernehmerleistungen Neubau Gesamtschule Berliner Straße, Bochum-Wattenscheid
description: Die Stadt Bochum realisiert im Rahmen ihres Schulbau- und Schulmodernisierungsprogramms die Erweiterung der Gesamtschule Mitte von vier auf sechs Züge und verlagert deren Standort an die Berliner Straße in Bochum-Wattenscheid. Gegenstand der Beschaffung sind Totalunternehmer-/Totalübernehmerleistungen für Planung und Errichtung eines Schulgebäudekomplexes für rund 1.400 Schülerinnen und Schüler einschließlich eines funktional zugehörigen, räumlich abgegrenzten Gebäudeteils für die Musikschule Bochum Wattenscheid. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst neben den Schul- und Musikschulgebäuden sämtliche für den Betrieb erforderlichen Ausstattungen und nutzerspezifischen Einbauten, Außenanlagen sowie die verkehrliche und mediale Erschließung einschließlich erforderlicher Maßnahmen außerhalb des unmittelbaren Baugrundstücks. Zu realisieren sind insbesondere moderne Lern- und Fachraumbereiche, Forum und Mensa, Verwaltungs-, Aufenthalts-, Technik- und Nebenräume sowie Freianlagen einschließlich Entwässerungsmulden mit einer Gesamtgröße von rund 1.500 m². Die Planung hat die räumliche Trennung der Bereiche der Sekundarstufen I und II, jahrgangsbezogene Lerncluster, barrierefreie und übersichtliche Raumkonzepte sowie die funktionalen Anforderungen einer Gesamtschule und Musikschule zu berücksichtigen. Das Bauwerk soll dauerhaft, nachhaltig, wirtschaftlich sowie wartungs- und instandhaltungsfreundlich ausgestaltet und an künftige Anforderungen des Schulbetriebs anpassbar sein. Der Leistungsraum umfasst insbesondere die ehemalige Sportanlage, eine derzeit als Tankstelle genutzte Fläche, die angrenzende Zufahrtsstraße sowie gegebenenfalls Flächen des benachbarten Parkplatzes; Höhenunterschiede des Geländes sind planerisch zu berücksichtigen. Der aktuelle Stand des in Aufstellung befindlichen Bebauungsplans Nr. 1001 "Gesamtschule Berliner Straße" wird den zur Angebotsabgabe aufgeforderten Unternehmen als Grundlage zur Verfügung gestellt.

description: This is not a solicitation, and quotes are not being requested. This notice is to provide the sole source justification as required under RFO 6.104-1. This procurement is for Non-Emergent Medical Transportation (NEMT) services and was conducted in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. In accordance with RFO 12.102, Restricting Competition for the acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services requires a justification using the format as described in RFO 6.104-1. A sole source, short term, six (6) week emergency contract is essential to provide vital healthcare services for Veterans at PVAHCS. This requirement ensures continued access to critical healthcare services while the long-term contract is competitively solicited. This requirement was awarded as a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. Non-Emergent Medical Transportation services are required by statute under 38 USC 111A. Services include pre-arranged, scheduled, unscheduled, and will call door-to-door service from beneficiary�s apartments and homes, and other areas designated by the Patient Travel Office (PTO) to get to and from scheduled medical appointments. It also includes discharges from PVAHCS inpatient wards, the Emergency Department, as well as transports to and from contracted nursing homes. This short-term bridge contract is needed to ensure regulatory compliance and continuity of mission critical services for 6 weeks, pending the award and performance start date of the competively solicited long-term contract.

description: NOTICE OF SOLE SOURCE The United States Fish and Wildlife Service intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis to a qualified contractor for the required goods and/or services. Due to the urgent nature of the requirement, the Government identified a source that is capable of providing the required goods and/or services within the timeframe necessary to address immediate need. The identified source has the capability, availability, and resources necessary to fulfill the requirement and meet the Government�s required schedule. Based on the unusual and compelling urgency of the requirement, competitive procurement procedures were limited in accordance with FAR Subpart 13.106-1(b)(1)(i) and (ii). This action is being pursued on a sole-source basis to minimize operational disruption and obtain the required goods and/or services as quickly as practicable. title: Alternative Fuels & Feedstock Initiative to Add Value to Seed Oil Crops through Improved Preprocessing, Scalability, and Valorization of Product Streams
description: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA), Management & Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking an Expression of Interest (EOI) from prospective offerors to complement existing seed oil crop research efforts at the Biomass Feedstock National User Facility (BFNUF) through U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) funded work. Appropriate topics of research will develop a greater understanding of harvesting, storage, separations, and scalability that increase the value of seed oil crops by reducing processing costs, increasing yields, and/or generating material streams that can be valorized. Topics that are not of interest to this EOI include operations upstream of harvesting (e.g., agronomy, crop engineering, genetic engineering), and downstream of processing (e.g., new conversion technologies). This effort expects to fund a maximum of two projects through DOE�s Alternative Fuels & Feedstock Office (AFFO). Projects can be led by industry or a U.S. university, with INL collaboration. BACKGROUND AFFO and Idaho National Laboratory (INL) seek research that improves post?harvest preprocessing, storage, separations, and scalable fractionation of seed oil crops to reduce costs, increase yields, and create valuable non?oil product streams. Work must focus on post?harvest operations and demonstrate scalability. Awardees will collaborate with INL�s BFNUF and generate data supporting an INL?led technoeconomic assessment (TEA) SCOPE OF WORK BEA is seeking qualified company or U.S University to support the BFNUF and AFFO mission through novel research that increases the value of seed oil crops through more effective harvesting, storage, fractionation, and/or valorization for seed components. If the proposed work is bench-scale, a case must be made for why it is scalable to field applications. Proposed research may focus on commodity or niche seed oil crops. More niche seed feedstocks will be considered if the research team can demonstrate the extent to which the proposed methods are broadly applicable. EOIs should focus on the non-oil components of the seed, although outcomes affecting the oil extraction process can be considered in the overall potential impact of the proposed work. The winning project team will collaborate with INL and help design INL scope that uses BFNUF capabilities, which may be reviewed at Biomass Feedstock National User Facility - Idaho National Laboratory. Qualifications for successful applicants include: Technical Expertise and Leadership: Strong technical credentials and experience, demonstrated by impactful research publications. There will be a preference for teams with experience collaborating with industrial partners or in performing industrially relevant research. Collaboration and Networking: Demonstrated ability to work with and lead teams from different organizations. Industry and Workforce Development Connections: Extensive ties with agricultural companies, equipment manufacturers, and/or energy sectors. Interested applicants will propose scope to address the research challenge posed. It is anticipated that the project duration will be between 12 and 24 months and will support approximately 0.25 FTEs for project PI and 1.0 � 3.0 FTEs for technicians/post docs/students. In addition to labor, the project may include laboratory consumables commensurate with the proposed scope. Any non-consumable equipment purchases, or planned travel must be specified in the proposed scope and is subject to approval by INL. Project resources required to fund BEA and BFNUF activities are separate from the awarded amount, which will be managed through a contract with BEA. As determined by BEA, responders to this EOI may receive a Request for Proposal (RFP) that may require detailed technical and price proposals for evaluation and ranking in a selection process. PROCESS This EOI is the first step in identifying interested and qualified vendors for future solicitation. Responses may be used to inform the development of a formal solicitation list. Selected vendors may be invited to participate in a Request for Proposal (RFP) process for award consideration. SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS Interested individuals are requested to email expressions of interest to BFNUF@inl.gov and chase.egbert@inl.gov by 6PM Mountain Standard Time on October 23, 2026. Included must be sufficient written information confirming the responder�s qualifications, including the following: � For all core team members (no page limit): Name Institution Contact Information CV or Resume � A brief statement (no more than three - five pages in length) including: The objective of the planned proposed work The approach to meeting the research objective The scale and technology readiness level of the proposed work Team members, resources, and roles for each team member How the team will collaborate with the BFNUF and include an INL-led TEA Expressions of interest may be submitted by 1) Contacting BFNUF@inl.gov to receive a link to securely transmit your application using Box, or 2) Emailed directly to BFNUF@inl.gov and chase.egbert@inl.gov. If you do the latter, please enable encryption features in your email platform to ensure secure transmission. Securely sending emails protects sensitive information from unauthorized access. Transmitting PII via non-secured methods carries inherent risks for which you are accountable. Only potentially qualified offerors, as determined by BEA, will be contacted for further discussions or the release of a request for proposal for the project. Interested individuals are advised that the selection decision is anticipated in January 2027. If you have questions, need additional information, or need to speak with a BEA subject matter expert for clarification, please email BFNUF@inl.gov. For further questions regarding BFNUF capabilities, please reach out via email at BFNUF@inl.gov. Proposing teams should anticipate collecting information that will support a technoeconomic assessment completed by INL. Deadline for submission:?October 23, 2026 Submit to:?Chase.Egbert@inl.gov and BFNUF@inl.gov PROPRIETARY INFORMATION Because information received in response to this EOI may be business sensitive or proprietary to the responding party, respondents must mark information in their responses accordingly.

description: Headquarters (HQ) Air Mobility Command (AMC) Communications Directorate (A67A) requires the purchase of Brand Name Only Palo Alto software. Palo Alto is a virtual (software) firewall that supports EACN's 10 gigabit architecture and enhances customer connection ability. The licenses required for this requirement are Palo Alto Networks VM-Series, Next Gen Firewall (NGFW) credits for Threat Prevention and Palo Alto Networks Premium Support Program for Panorama. The BNO Palo Alto Software is required to support EACN�s security policies to maintain positive control of the network, improve security efficacy and reduce security response times. These virtual machines are needed to analyze traffic to identify users/applications and determine applicable content. Without these licenses, EACN would become significantly compromised, presenting a larger attack surface for potential cyber threats. In addition, a gap in support could cause a network interruption in communications service and security. Palo Alto is the only software certified to be used with EACN and is the industry standard. Palo Alto is an other than small business selling these licenses through authorized resellers.

title: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Less Lethal Specialty Impact/Chemical Munitions (LLSI CM) Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Law Enforcement Safety and Compliance Directorate (LESC), on behalf of Operations Support (OS), U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), and U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is conducting market research to gain a greater understanding of the full range of available options for industry�s ability to provide CBP with suitable Distraction Devices, Specialty Impact and Chemical Munitions, hand delivered and launched in 40mm launchers which meet the government�s preliminarily identified requirements. This is an RFI released pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 � Market Research. This RFI�s purpose is to obtain market information on viable sources of supply, industry practices, answers to specific questions, and industry comments. All RFI submissions become Government property and will not be returned. This announcement constitutes an official Request for Information (RFI). Further, U.S. Customs and Border Protection is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Your response to this RFI will be treated as information only. No entitlement to payment of direct or indirect costs or charges by the Government will arise as a result of contractor submission of responses to this announcement or Government use of such information. No funds have been authorized, appropriated, or received for this effort. The information provided may be used by CBP in developing and refining its Acquisition Strategy, Statement of Work, and Performance Specifications. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or competition sensitive information contained in their response. The U.S. Government does not intend to award a contract solely on the basis of this RFI or to otherwise pay for the information submitted in response to same. The U.S. Government is not obligated to notify respondents of the results of this survey. DESCRIPTION This initiative, Less Lethal Specialty Impact/Chemical Munitions, is an updated requirement to allow U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Components, and other federal agencies the ability to supply their armed workforce with Distraction Devices, Specialty Impact and Chemical Munitions, hand delivered and launched in 40mm launchers, for training and operational use, while achieving significant cost savings. CBP intends to solicit for a 5-year Indefinite Delivery / Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Contract. This contract is intended to be a Multi-Agency Contract (MAC). INFORMATION REQUESTED: Company Name, Company Address, Point of Contact, Telephone Number, and e-mail Address. CBP intends to use North America Industrial Classification System (NAICS) 332994 Small Arms and other Ordnances and Accessories? What NAICS code do you think, if any, is more appropriate for CBP to use? What size business are you registered as with NAICS Code 332994? Are you a manufacturer or distributor/reseller of LLSI CMs? If you a distributor, are you an authorized distributor capable of providing an authorization letter from the manufacturer? What is your organization�s experience with, and capability of, manufacturing and distributing less lethal distraction devices, specialty impact and chemical munitions for military or law enforcement agencies? Does this experience include designing specific devices to meet agency/military technical requirements? Where are your devices manufactured and/or assembled? If parts/components are manufactured in a different location from final assembly, please identify all subcontractors� names and locations. What percentage of the devices are manufactured and assembled in the U.S.? Is your organization capable of manufacturing or providing devices that meet all technical requirements included in the attached draft Statement of Work (SOW)? If not, please identify the items that you are NOT able to provide? Does your organization offer the devices with a warranty? If yes, please provide warranty length, and coverage of warranty. Is your organization (or the manufacturer) ISO Certified? If so, to what standard? Provide a synopsis of current Quality Control processes related to the devices. Provide your total manufacturing capacity for all categories of devices outlined in the draft Statement of Work on a quarterly basis. What is your surge capacity for each category of device outlined in the draft Statement of Work that will be devoted to this contract? What is the normal lead-time for delivery of devices once an order is received? Do you have any concerns or questions regarding the requirements set forth in the attached draft Statement of Work? RESPONSES The information provided may be used by CBP in developing and refining its Acquisition Strategy, Statement of Work, and Performance Specifications. Responses shall be the minimum length necessary to accommodate all requested information and submitted via e-mail only. Proprietary information, if any, should be minimized and MUST BE CLEARLY MARKED. To aid the Government, please segregate proprietary information. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on the official Government Point of Entry site System for Award Management (SAM.gov) website. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to monitor these sites for additional information pertaining to this requirement. QUESTIONS Questions regarding this announcement shall be submitted in writing by e-mail to the Contracting Officer, email address listed below. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions, if not answered directly to the respondee, will be answered by posting on the SAM.gov website; accordingly, questions shall NOT contain proprietary, sensitive, or classified information. Instructions and Response Guidelines: Please provide the information you deem relevant in order to respond to the specific inquiries of the RFI. The information provided will be used solely by CBP as market research. This RFI is for information and planning purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Invitation for Bid, or Request for Quotation (RFQ), and it is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract, nor will the Government pay for the information submitted in response to this request. All information contained in this RFI is preliminary as well as subject to modification and is in no way binding on the Government. RFI Responses shall be submitted electronically via email to the Contacting Officer, Jared Tritle at Jared.a.tritle@cbp.dhs.gov no later than 2:00 p.m. EST on Friday, October 24, 2025. Telephone responses will not be accepted. The Government is not required to respond to any information provided in response to this RFI. It is the responsibility of the interested parties to monitor SAM.gov for additional information pertaining to this RFI.

description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове медицински изделия и консумативи за нуждите на ,,МБАЛ -Благоевград" АД. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови медицински изделия и/или консумативи и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към документацията „Техническа спецификация" са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените медицински изделия и консумативи, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. Обменът на документи и съобщения между Възложители, кандидати, участници и изпълнители на обществени поръчки се осъществява чрез Централизираната електронна платформа. Срокът на ДСП е 36 месеца . Динамичната система за покупки е отворена през целия си срок на действие за всеки кандидат, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Достъпът и участието в нея са свободни и безплатни за всички заинтересовани лица. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 /дванадесет/ месеца. Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се провежда на етапи. Съгласно чл.101 от ЗОП, в зависимост от етапа на процедурата кандидатите подават заявления за участие, а квалифицираните (допуснати) кандидати - оферти. ДСП се управлява като изцяло електронен процес и през целия срок на действие на системата за покупки тя е открита за всеки стопански субект /изпълняващ орган/ИО/, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Посочените критерии за подбор, са и критерии за изключване. Възложителят осигурява пълен, неограничен и пряк достъп до документацията по настоящата процедура чрез Централизираната електронна платформа, наричана "платформата". Заявленията и офертите трябва да се изготвят и представят в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 101 от ЗОП и чл.47 от ППЗОП, в срока посочен в обявлението. Всяко заявление и Всяка оферта се подава в системата на ЦАИС ЕОП Първи етап /първоначално събиране на заявления за участие/: Квалифициране на доставчиците ( допускане на доставчиците до системата ) . На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 23.10.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления. Заявления могат да се подават и след крайния срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, в тези случаи кандидатите ще получават покани след одобряване на включването им в ДСП. Възложителят определя с Решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на Решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. Втори етап /събиране на оферти по конкретни покани/: Следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици, които са били квалифицирани/допуснати. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Съгласно чл.39, ал.1 от ППЗОП с подаването на оферта се счита, че кандидатите се съгласяват с всички условия на възложителя, в т.ч. с определения от него срок на валидност на офертите и с проекта на договор. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления, подадени в посоченият по-горе срок. При конкретни поръчки по покани офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. *По всяко време заинтересовани лица могат да подават заявления за допускане/включване в ДСП. Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите предложения два пъти в месеца (1- во и 15-то число на месеца ) или на две седмици веднъж. Възложителят ще издава решение за допускане на кандидатите в ДСП. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията Възложителят издава Решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се присъединяват към ДСП.​​​​​​​

title: Award to World Wide Technology LLC
description: The Naval Information Warfare Center (NIWC) Pacific has awarded a Commercial, Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order contract on a non-competitive basis to World Wide Technology (CAGE 0MNV1) in the amount of $837,965.00. The award was issued on 25 September 2026. This contract award is the successful operational transition of advanced technology validated during the Advanced Naval Technology Exercise (ANTX). Executed in alignment with the Navys strategic shift toward rapid deployment, the ANTX framework serves as a critical rapid-acquisition pipeline. The World Wide Technology, LLC contract if the first to leverage authority from the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering (OUSD(R AND E)), to award commercial contracts using ANTX evaluations as a competitive down-select.The ANTX brought together program office, commercial industry, government laboratories, and operational forces. A major benefit of this collaborative framework was providing industry partners with direct access to a state-of-the-art, high-fidelity testing sandbox. Within this safe, simulated realistic environment, vendors underwent rigorous technical assessments and received direct, real-time feedback.

description: (a) The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: Technical b) Authorized Distributor Delivery Date Price Technical: The quotation will be evaluated to the extent to which it can meet and/or exceed the Government's requirements as outlined in the solicitation and based on the information requested in the instructions to offerors section of the solicitation. b) Authorized Distributor: Quote responses that are not submitted by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) must include an authorized distributor letter on OEM stationary, dated within 18 months of quote submission. Price: The Government will evaluate the price by adding the total of all line-item prices. The Total Evaluated Price will be that sum. Quotes will be evaluated by performing a direct comparison of one offer with another in a uniform manner to determine which quote provides the government with its needs, as identified in the RFQ. The government reserves the right to consider a response that offers more than the minimum and select that response if it provides a benefit to the government.
